annotations.title: Ask a question about a CSV

description: Ask a question about a CSV — Ask a plain-English question about CSV data and get an exact answer. The model only writes a query plan (filters, group by, sum/avg/min/max/median/count/distinct, sort, limit) from your column schema; the plan then runs deterministically on your rows, so totals and averages are computed, not guessed. Auto-detects comma, semicolon, tab or pipe delimiters, quoted fields, $ and (negative) amounts, dates. Up to 60,000 characters / 5,000 rows. Optional limit= (default 50, max 200). Returns answer, result rows, the plan and warnings. Example: ?csv=region,revenue%0AEast,1200%0AWest,800&question=total revenue by region Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).

question.description: total revenue by region, highest first

name: ai_csv_ask
